effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] By placing 1 [Doomsday Clock] from your hand or trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, you may play 2 [Diaboromon] Tokens without paying the cost. (Digimon/Cost 14/Lv.6/White/Mega/Unknown/Unidentified/3000 DP)
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may switch the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name.
